prediction_text: Prediction: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election (timing: fixed election date, 8 November 2016). What decides it is not Trump's strength but Clinton's damage: the email controversy and the Clinton Foundation controversies corrode her standing through the autumn until the apparently safe polling lead fails her.
basis: No tradition field on card; decided from the card's own genre: a tarot reading on the election (Manhattan, Union Square Park, August 2016; reported 26 Aug 2016) — no cards are carried on the card face, so the reading is reconstructed from the card-carried facets and the deciding-factor facet is answered from them. This case: 2016 election, winner plus what will decide it; card-carried facts = Clinton leads most August polls, her email controversy and the Clinton Foundation are already public controversies. Facet check: main facet (winner) answered; deciding-factor facet answered from the two card-carried controversy facets (two pointers, kept at full granularity as the deciding mechanism). Note of limits: the drawn cards themselves are not on the card, so no card-by-card basis can be cited — confidence is lowered accordingly rather than inventing a spread.
